settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.app_name_helper: Shown in the web app, in the e-mails and by security keys. Changing it logs every user out
settings.mail_from_address_helper: E-mails go through the cluster smarthost. Leave empty to use the smarthost user name, or noreply@ followed by the host name
settings.mail_from_address_pattern: Must be a valid e-mail address
settings.app_settings_saved_description: These settings are stored in the 2FAuth database. The values shown are the last ones saved from this page. They are applied when you save
settings.disable_registration_tooltip: Nobody can create an account with the registration form. Register the first account, which becomes the administrator, before you disable registration. Also available in the 2FAuth Admin panel
settings.enable_sso_tooltip: Show the OpenID Connect and GitHub login buttons for the providers configured below
settings.use_sso_only_tooltip: Users can log in only with OpenID Connect or GitHub. Password and security key logins are disabled
settings.keep_sso_registration_enabled: Create accounts at first SSO login
settings.keep_sso_registration_enabled_tooltip: A user who logs in with SSO for the first time gets an account, even when registration is disabled
settings.openid_description: Create a client in your identity provider with the redirect URI below, then enter its client ID, client secret and endpoints
settings.openid_callback_url: Redirect URI to register with the provider
settings.openid_http_verify_ssl_peer_tooltip: Disable only for a provider with a self-signed certificate
settings.github_description: Create an OAuth app in the GitHub developer settings with the authorization callback URL below, then enter its client ID and client secret
settings.github_callback_url: Authorization callback URL to register with GitHub
settings.client_id_helper: Leave empty to disable this provider. Its saved secret is removed
settings.secret_keep_helper: Leave empty to keep the saved secret
settings.cli_only_note: More 2FAuth settings, such as the timezone, logs, throttling, session lifetime and user preferences, can be set with the configure-module action. See the module README
settings.unsafe_chars: Quotes and backslashes are not allowed
settings.url_pattern: Must be a URL starting with https:// or http://
settings.client_secret_required: Required: no secret is saved for this provider
settings.sso_only_requires_provider: SSO only needs SSO enabled and a configured OpenID Connect or GitHub provider
settings.app_name_pattern: Quotes and backslashes are not allowed

settings.github_client_id_pattern: Quotes and backslashes are not allowed
settings.openid_authorize_url_pattern: Must be a URL starting with https:// or http://
settings.openid_token_url_pattern: Must be a URL starting with https:// or http://
settings.openid_userinfo_url_pattern: Must be a URL starting with https:// or http://
